# Public-domain test music

These local test recordings come from the
[Musopen Kickstarter Music FLAC collection](https://archive.org/details/MusopenCollectionAsFlac).
Archive.org identifies the collection with the
[Public Domain Mark 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/).
Musopen commissioned the recordings and released them into the public domain.

The FLAC files are intentionally ignored by Git because they total about 186 MB:

- `beethoven-coriolan-overture.flac`
  - Ludwig van Beethoven, *Coriolan Overture, Op. 62*
  - Czech National Symphony Orchestra / Musopen
  - 8:18.70, 48 kHz stereo, 24-bit FLAC, 84 MB
  - SHA-256: `2949526b38864ba2cee698f3e29e6881c93c1462df97606630940987e81ef0c3`
  - Source file: `Beethoven_CoriolanOverture/LudwigVanBeethoven-CoriolanOverture.flac`
- `grieg-in-the-hall-of-the-mountain-king.flac`
  - Edvard Grieg, *Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46: In the Hall of the Mountain King*
  - Czech National Symphony Orchestra / Musopen
  - 2:34.09, 48 kHz stereo, 24-bit FLAC, 25 MB
  - SHA-256: `1c1be6b3e0042ee031cee42a8d151b04c78bfccf3126c4de6271e7b2fdcb6937`
  - Source file: `Greig_PeerGynt/EdvardGrieg-PeerGyntSuiteNo.1Op.46-04-InTheHallOfTheMountainKing.flac`
- `mozart-magic-flute-overture.flac`
  - Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, *The Magic Flute Overture*
  - Czech National Symphony Orchestra / Musopen
  - 6:40.77, 48 kHz stereo, 24-bit FLAC, 68 MB
  - SHA-256: `d0482d54438d784ab6c0ff2d2279e10fa821f7b6fec9f7da43bfed5701cb25ac`
  - Source file: `Mozart_MagicFluteOverture/WolfgangAmadeusMozart-MagicFluteOverture.flac`
